consumer:ny_it201.ask.state_resident@ny_.question_phrase: a New York State resident for all of 2025
consumer:ny_it201.ask.state_resident@ny_.source_phrase: p. 3, "If you were a New York State resident for only part of the year, do not file Form IT-201."
consumer:ny_it201.ask.state_resident@ny_.reason: The gate refuses the part-year (or nonresident) case p. 3 sends to Form IT-203; the question asks the full-year residence p. 30 defines.

consumer:ny_it201.ask.city_resident@ny_i.question_phrase: a New York City resident ... for all of 2025
consumer:ny_it201.ask.city_resident@ny_i.source_phrase: p. 14, Line 50, "If you were a New York City resident for only part of 2025, complete Form IT-360.1"
consumer:ny_it201.ask.city_resident@ny_i.reason: A No is the part-year (or non-) City resident case line 50 sends to Form IT-360.1; the gate refuses it.

consumer:ny_it201.ask.it225@ny_it201i:p7.question_phrase: any other New York addition or subtraction on Form IT-225
consumer:ny_it201.ask.it225@ny_it201i:p7.source_phrase: p. 7, Step 4, "See below and Form IT-225, New York State Modifications, and its instructions."
consumer:ny_it201.ask.it225@ny_it201i:p7.reason: The question asks whether any IT-225 modification applies, which is what p. 7 and the line 23 and 31 instructions (p. 8, p. 10) send to Form IT-225.

consumer:ny_it201.ask.itemize@ny_it201i:.question_phrase: itemize deductions on your New York return (Form IT-196)
consumer:ny_it201.ask.itemize@ny_it201i:.source_phrase: p. 11, "To calculate your New York itemized deduction, use Form IT-196"
consumer:ny_it201.ask.itemize@ny_it201i:.reason: The question asks whether the filer itemizes on Form IT-196, the case p. 11 describes; the gate refuses it.

consumer:ny_it201.ask.owes_use_tax@ny_it.question_phrase: owe New York sales or use tax on purchases made without paying New York tax
consumer:ny_it201.ask.owes_use_tax@ny_it.source_phrase: p. 19, "If you do not owe any sales or use tax, you must enter 0 on line 59."
consumer:ny_it201.ask.owes_use_tax@ny_it.reason: A No is the case p. 19 says to enter 0 for; the question restates p. 18's "You owe sales or compensating use tax if you" conditions.
